== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Wuher (V)]] (Original text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/73ae2bd94d3bb50c349b1a37df01b994962a4a80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/wuher.gif Holotable image repository, commit 73ae2bd] “Set 23 Preview”, 20 December 2023, the Virtual Set 23 preview. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.
